hooks.text: Uranus orbits the Sun knocked completely on its side.
One planet rolls through space on its side.
One planet endures 42 years of continuous darkness.

title: Why Uranus Orbits the Sun on Its Side
description: Uranus has an extreme axial tilt of nearly 98 degrees, subjecting its poles to 42 years of continuous daylight followed by 42 years of total darkness.

beats.text: Uranus orbits the Sun knocked completely on its side.
beats.visual: illustration of Uranus rotating on its side along its orbit, 2021

beats.text: Most people expect planets to spin like upright tops.
beats.visual: diagram comparing planetary spin axes in the Solar System, 2020
queries: Solar system planetary tilt comparison diagram

beats.text: But Uranus rotates with a tilt of nearly 98 degrees.
beats.visual: diagram of Uranus's 98-degree axial tilt and rotational axis, 2018

beats.text: Scientists think a collision with a giant protoplanet flipped it.
beats.visual: artist concept of an ancient giant protoplanet colliding with Uranus, 2018

beats.text: During its 84-year orbit around the Sun, its poles alternate.
beats.visual: diagram of Uranus orbiting the Sun showing light hitting the poles, 2019
queries: Uranus orbit around Sun seasons diagram

beats.text: One pole gets 42 years of nonstop sunlight.
beats.visual: Hubble Space Telescope photo of Uranus illuminated pole with aurora, 2014

beats.text: Then it plunges into 42 years of total darkness.
beats.visual: artist concept of the dark hemisphere of Uranus facing deep space, 2020
queries: Uranus dark side deep space illustration
Uranus shadow night side concept art

beats.text: Temperatures drop to minus 224 degrees Celsius in that freeze.
beats.visual: Voyager 2 true-color cyan disk image of Uranus atmosphere, 1986

beats.text: That extreme environment explains why it rolls around the Sun.
beats.visual: wide render of Uranus orbiting the Sun on its side against stars, 2022
queries: Uranus orbiting Sun space view rendering

better_than_last: Applies proven rule of busting common upright planetary rotational beliefs by grounding the extreme 42-year dark pole consequence before executing a tight circular ending.
